votes.quote: A marker at the end of an absolute path returns an empty string. `/home/me/code` returns `""`. The dash branch skips a marker in last position, but the absolute-path branch doesn't, because its check `index <= parts.length - 1` is always true. It should probably be `<`, as in the dash branch.
